content: Schema/column-signature matching in practice: normalize header text (lowercase, strip whitespace/punctuation), then build an order-independent signature by sorting the normalized header set and hashing (e.g. sha256 of a joined sorted list) or n-gram/phonetic fingerprinting for fuzzier matching. Simple sorted-tuple hashing is the standard lightweight approach for exact repeat-schema detection; heavier fingerprinting (n-grams, value overlap) is used for fuzzy/approximate matching across differently-named schemas.
